selection_rule: Select the first central empirical quantitative claim associated with a primary results table in Section 4 (Table 1: Agent Refining Performance), demonstrating the core method advantage of RICE refining over baseline refining methods across representative environments.
claim_text: RICE refining method brings the largest improvement for the target agent in performance (measured by final reward) after refining compared to baseline refining methods (PPO fine-tuning, JSRL, StateMask-R) across representative environments when using the same explanation method.
scope_notes: Out-of-scope per ordinary addendum: Malware Mutation environment, Sparse-Walker2d game, hyper-parameter sensitivity of sparse MuJoCo games, qualitative analysis of autonomous driving, and claimed performance difference between Ours and StateMask explanation methods in Table 1.
